Meet the owner

Dr. Milad Karamlou

A graduate of the Schulich School of Medicine and Dentistry at Western University, Dr. Karamlou continued his training in the General Practice Residency program at The Ohio State University.

His current Vaughan profile describes training and continuing education in oral surgery, implant dentistry, anesthesia, cosmetic dentistry, and comprehensive care. It also notes that he is certified in IV sedation. This supplied biography connects the two locations and remains subject to the clinic’s final approval.

Hospital-based trainingGeneral Practice Residency at The Ohio State University.
